child.label: Africa
child.description: Questions about countries in Africa, including Egypt, Morocco, Algeria, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Kenya, Tanzania, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and South Africa.
child.not_for: Middle Eastern countries such as Saudi Arabia, Israel and Iran go to Asia.
examples: Is Kenya the best country for a safari?
Is Nigeria the most populous country in Africa?

child.label: Asia
child.description: Questions about countries in Asia and the Middle East, including China, Japan, South Korea, India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines, Malaysia, Myanmar, Singapore, Iran, Israel and Saudi Arabia.
child.not_for: Russia and Turkey go to Europe; Egypt goes to Africa; Australia goes to Oceania.
examples: Is Japan the safest country to visit in Asia?

child.label: Europe
child.description: Questions about countries in Europe, including the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Poland, Russia and Turkey.
child.not_for: Countries of the Middle East go to Asia.
examples: Is Italy overrated as a tourist destination?
Is Russia the largest country in the world?

child.label: Americas
child.description: Questions about countries in North, Central and South America, including the United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina and Colombia.
examples: Is Canada more interesting than people give it credit for?
Is Brazil the largest country in South America?

child.label: Oceania
child.description: Questions about countries in Oceania, including Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific island nations.
child.not_for: Southeast Asian countries such as Indonesia go to Asia.
examples: Is Australia worth the long flight for a vacation?
